notes.title: Orbyss Soundtrack announcement
notes.content: [p]The original soundtrack of Orbyss, by Pierre Estève, will be released in October 2025[/p][p]Immerse yourself in the evocative soundtrack of [b]Orbyss[/b], crafted by renowned composer [b]Pierre Estève[/b], celebrated for his work on the [i]Atlantis[/i] series and other acclaimed video game scores.[/p][p align="start"]Blending deep electronic textures, organic soundscapes, and abstract melodies, this soundtrack captures the emotional arc of the game — from the resonant echoes of the abyss, through storms of energy and moments of harmony.[/p][p align="start"]Designed as both a companion to the gameplay and a standalone musical journey, Pierre Estève’s compositions invite you to relive the game’s most striking moments, or simply lose yourself in a world where light and sound tell the story.[/p][p]Wishlist the soundtrack on Steam:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3890470/Orbyss_Soundtrack/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Games Against Living Miserably 2025
notes.content:
[p]Games are great. We all know that. But did you know they can also be great for your head?[/p][p]Running from 8–15 September, to mark World Suicide Prevention Day, Orbyss will take part in Games Against Living Miserably 2025 - the event on Steam that celebrates how games can help us unwind, connect, and escape.[/p][p]It’s presented by Curve Games and the suicide prevention charity, Campaign Against Living Miserably (@thecalmzone).[/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/curvedigital/sale/GALM25"]https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/curvedigital/sale/GALM25[/url][/p][p][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Games Made in France!
notes.content:
Orbyss is part of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/gamesmadeinfrance]Games Made in France 2025[/url] event! There are a few dozens of incredible French games that will be covered this year, so if you speak french, be sure to have a look!

Orbyss will be presented tomorrow, [b]Sunday May 18, at 3:35pm[/b], by DamDamLive and Ultia.

The event is streamed on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/mistermv]Mister MV’s Twitch channel[/url].

notes.title: Orbyss Demo update
notes.content:
Correction of GPU usage problems + various improvements

- Added VSync option (ON by default)
- Added Frame Rate Limit option ("Max FPS")
- Added Motion Blur option
- Few other minor UX improvements

Thanks everyone for your feedback!
